messages:
statusbot: Incident broadcast — elevated 503 errors observed across multi-region ingress (eu-west + us-west). Start: ~10:12 UTC. Approx 7–9% of generative API requests returning 503. Customers impacted: hosted API customers using /v1/generate and streaming. Incident page: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2048201234 — updates will be posted here. Please funnel triage updates to #incidents and mitigation chatter to #eng-runtime

anya (sre): Investigating. Initial signal shows LB retry loops + backend connection exhaustion. Correlating with a deploy of a kernel tuning hotpatch at 09:58 that changed connection keepalive/timeout behavior.

mike (support): Seeing ~15 customers open tickets within the last 20m, escalating a few to enterprise CS. Prepared a proactive customer note, pinging CS for send.

jen (eng-runtime): Confirmed the 09:58 hotpatch touched the TCP keepalive path. Rolling back the hotpatch in eu-west now to restore previous connection behavior. Will iterate to us-west after confirmation.

ops-bot: Auto-scale triggered: added +8 Fargate/GPU serving nodes across eu-west/us-west. Scale action IDs: act-9751, act-9752 (logs in infra).

sara (sre): Throttled top noisy clients with a temporary per-route rate limiter to reduce tail pressure — applied ruleset rl-temporary-2048. This should cut the retry amplification while we roll back.

support_oncall: Drafted customer-facing message (short): "We're aware of elevated 503s impacting generation endpoints. Engineers are mitigating; we'll share ETA within 15 minutes. See https://status.redwood.example/incident/2048201234 for live updates." Ready to send when SRE 👍

miguel (platform): Observed KV-cache eviction spike coincident with increased connection failures — eviction rate +12% across eu-west pools. Might be secondary pressure from retry storms. Collecting tracer dumps.

anya (sre): Quick status check: eu-west rollback in progress, error rate dropping from ~8% -> ~1.5% over last 6 minutes. us-west still ~2.1% but trending down; rollback queued and will start in 2m.

jen (eng-runtime): Rollback finished in eu-west, health checks green. us-west rollback started. Rolling restart of ingress proxies to clear stuck connections.

mike (support): Sending proactive note to customers now (using approved template). Will attach incident page link and temporary mitigations.

ops-bot: Canary+full rollout of rollback confirmed for eu-west. us-west rollback 40% complete. Autoscale actions stable.

anya (sre): Current metrics: eu-west 503 rate ~1.2%, us-west ~0.9% (post-rollback and throttling). Still monitoring for any regression. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.example/runbooks/ingress-503-response

jen (eng-runtime): Quick snippet from the failing trace that led us to the hotpatch (for root cause follow-up):
```
TCP: retransmit timeout triggered xN
keepalive: unexpected close on forward path
LB: retry loop increment -> backend connection saturate
```

support_oncall: FYI CS sent update to affected customers at 10:37 UTC. Template included apology, mitigations, and link to status page.

miguel (platform): Continued KV metrics look stabilizing. Eviction rate returning toward baseline. Collecting heap/eviction histograms for postmortem.

anya (sre): Will keep monitoring for 30m. If no regression, we’ll mark this as mitigated and begin post-incident review. Please add any customer escalations to the incident page.

ops-bot: Next scheduled automated update in 10 minutes. Manual updates allowed in meantime.

anya (sre): Update 30m later — incident mitigated and 503 errors returned to baseline across all affected regions. Root cause: unintended side-effect from kernel tuning hotpatch that altered connection keepalive semantics under high retry loads; combo with bursty clients amplified retry loops. Postmortem owner assigned: jen (eng-runtime). Postmortem ETA: 48 hours. Closing broadcast — follow the incident page for the postmortem and action items. :white_check_mark:
